productArea.name: Repository activity
productArea.scope: Inspect the repository activity overview, contributors, code frequency, and recent commits using date ranges, chart controls, and summary links. Verify link destinations without exploring the linked issues, pull requests, releases, or code.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Activity in the seeded repository and change its overview period.
Choose Contributors within Activity and inspect its chart controls.
Choose Code Frequency within Activity and inspect its chart controls.
Choose Recent Commits within Activity and inspect its chart controls.
